opening: I have pain on the left side of my chest.
The chest pain and the cough have been going on for the past week.
I have a cough that brings up phlegm.
I was diagnosed with the flu recently.

opening.text: I've got pain on the left side of my chest, a cough that brings up phlegm, and I've been short of breath. I've also had a fever. All of this has been going on for the past week. I was diagnosed with the flu recently.
